correctness.rationale: The actual cyclic update on K_{a,b} factors exactly through nonempty shore-color supports, each one of 49 mask pairs. Every pair is recorded in a complete deterministic transition table. The only recurrent supports are three diagonal singletons, the full/full pair, and three two-cycles of 2-element support; direct per-color update proves labelled periods 1, 3, and 4 rather than assuming support periods are configuration periods. Grouping by shore-support cardinalities yields exactly six (first periodic-entry time, eventual minimal period) classes and their closed formulas via onto-function inclusion-exclusion. The six counts sum to 3^{a+b} algebraically. The conditional asymptotic uses an exact difference identity and the min(a,b)→infinity limit. Actual extracted scientific code checked 72,720 labelled configurations and 196 symbolic parameter pairs; the infinite-family proof is the finite support factor and exact counting, not brute-force extrapolation.

value.rationale: This is the complete basin-entry time and primitive-period census, not just a renamed synchronization theorem. Full four-cycle orbit counts and one-step transient oscillatory basins distinguish this cyclic-excitation map from the separately studied inhibitory firefly update on the same graph family, where oscillatory initial states are already periodic. The asymptotic conditional concentration quantifies a natural rare-event transition: among starts not already in a three-cycle, the four-cycle one-step basin dominates for arbitrary simultaneously growing shores. All shore sizes are covered by closed natural formulas, supporting finite-size and probabilistic comparisons.
